no-trade-skeptic.thesis: NO TRADE. Verified: the Sep 16 Fed 25bp hike to 3.75-4.00% was already >90% priced; BoJ 25bp to 1.25% and BoE 6-3 hold are spent; SOFR 3.85% with ICE 1M path to 4.1975 by Dec-26 and 4.6025 by Aug-28, CORRA 2.29% with MX path only to 2.58 by Dec-26, AONIA 4.35% with ASX cash-futures +21.5bp by Oct and +51bp by Mar-27; US 2Y 4.76 / 10Y 5.01 at 99.8/99.6 1y percentiles with 2s10s +25bp at the 0.2 1y percentile but 54th 5y; CA-US 2Y -140bp (3.8th 1y / 4.3rd 5y) and CA-US 10Y -111bp (0.2 1y) sit next to policy-path divergence of ~+35bp US vs +29bp CA into year-end; AU 2Y/10Y 4.999/5.348 at 99th 1y with housing already down >7% from peak; CFTC 2026-09-15 trader-class nets are all null while AUD/JPY/CHF OI sit at ~99th percentile; NZ B2 yields, NZ policy path, live AU OIS, CME volume, and executable broker marks are missing. Inference: percentile extremes and CA-US cheapness are discovery signals of a priced global-tightening/energy regime, not a residual mispricing; same-move analogs for CA-US 2Y/10Y and US 2Y hike-month episodes are two-way; AUDNZD/AUDCAD/USDCHF 99.8th 1y FX stretches cannot be sized without nets or executable spots. Unknown: next dated unspent catalyst, meeting probabilities (packet methods are monthly-average SOFR/CORRA/AONIA, not FOMC odds), NZ rates, CFTC direction, live AU OIS. Cash 5% ACT/365 on undeployed $100m (~$13,699/day) beats any unlevelled, post-event, analog-noisy expression. Actionable only if live marks plus a policy-path residual not already in SOFR/CORRA/AONIA, signed CFTC nets, restored NZ B2, current-vintage AU OIS, and a dated unspent catalyst whose analogs resolve one way after regime differences.
